senses.gloss: m. = h. שׁוּק III, market, open place, street.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 1:20">Targ. Prov. I, 20</cite> (h. text (<cite ref="H00429"><he>חוּץ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 9:22">Targ. Gen. IX, 22</cite> (Y. ed. Vien. <cite ref="U00523"><he>שׁוֹקָא</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 22a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>נקיט ליה ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N01191"><he>נְקַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 110a:3">Pes. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>חזי אפי ש׳</he> went out in the open air, v. <cite ref="U00521"><he>שׁוּק</he> III</cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:9:3">Cant. R. to VIII, 9</cite> <he>נפיק ליה לש׳ וכ׳</he> went to market to buy goods (v. <cite ref="M02431"><he>מְקָמָא</he> II</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>שׁוּקִין</he>, <he>שׁוּקַיָּא</he>, <he>שׁוּקֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 22:43">Targ. II Sam. XXII, 43</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="U01849"><he>שקי</he></cite>, corr. acc.; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:43">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 43</cite> <he>אשקקי</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 24:11">Targ. Is. XXIV, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 7:12">Targ. Prov. VII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:7:2">Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15ᵈ</cite> <he>בש׳ דארמאי</he> in the streets of the gentiles; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:9:2">Y. Ned. IV, 38ᵈ</cite> <he>בשׁוּקָאֵי</he>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="U01891"><he>שְׁקָקָא</he></cite>.
